data: For fiscal 2024, Apple reported net sales of $391.035 billion for the year ended September 28, 2024, and Microsoft reported revenue of $245.122 billion for the year ended June 30, 2024. Apple's revenue was therefore about 1.60 times Microsoft's, a gap of roughly $145.9 billion. The two fiscal years do not line up: Apple's ends in late September and Microsoft's ends in June, so the periods overlap by only about three months.
